say:1:1130529001:1.text: We didn't expect him to be waiting for us! We figured he would've just moved on to Alkali...
say:1:1130529001:1.source_cn: 没想到皮特老板还在这里等着我们！我们还以为他早就自己带...
say:1:1130529001:1.male: We didn't expect him to be waiting for us! We figured he would've just moved on to Alkali...
say:1:1130529001:1.female: We didn't expect him to be waiting for us! We figured he would've just moved on to Alkali...

say:2:1130529002:1.text: But he didn't blame us for anything at all and even made sure we rested for a few days. He's truly kind.
say:2:1130529002:1.source_cn: 而且，他没有指责我们，还让我们休息几天再走，真是大好人啊。
say:2:1130529002:1.male: But he didn't blame us for anything at all and even made sure we rested for a few days. He's truly kind.
say:2:1130529002:1.female: But he didn't blame us for anything at all and even made sure we rested for a few days. He's truly kind.

say:3:1130529003:1.text: Now that the treasure-hunting craze has died down, excavation tools won't fetch as good of a price. But the important thing is that we're all still alive!
say:3:1130529003:1.source_cn: 虽然现在寻宝热一过，我们运来的开凿工具卖不上价了，不过...
say:3:1130529003:1.male: Now that the treasure-hunting craze has died down, excavation tools won't fetch as good of a price. But the important thing is that we're all still alive!
say:3:1130529003:1.female: Now that the treasure-hunting craze has died down, excavation tools won't fetch as good of a price. But the important thing is that we're all still alive!
